scenario: At 03:00 the scheduler runs expire-carts; cart c_17, last touched 3 days ago, should survive a 30-day TTL

route.note: the trigger: the 03:00 entry names expire-carts

links.note: the job name in the schedule matches its key in the registry

bugs.summary: DAY_MS is 24 minutes, so carts expire after 12 hours instead of 30 days
bugs.detail: DAY_MS = 24 * MINUTE_MS is 24 minutes, not 24 hours; daysAgo(30) is 12 hours ago, so the nightly job releases the stock of and deletes c_17 and any cart untouched for half a day. The admin page's stale list (7 days) shrinks to 2.8 hours the same way.
